title: Tim Tebow Returns to Empower Field to Open Broncos Season
seoTitle: Tim Tebow Returns to Empower Field for Broncos Opener
subtitle: The former quarterback will plant the alumni flag at Sunday's opener against the Jaguars
excerpt: Former quarterback Tim Tebow will return to Empower Field for Sunday's opener to plant the Broncos alumni flag, marking his first return to the stadium.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Former Denver Broncos quarterback Tim Tebow will return to Empower Field for Sunday's opener to plant the club's alumni flag, marking his first return to the stadium since 2012.

What changes in your pocket when the flag is planted

The event, which takes place prior to kickoff against the Jacksonville Jaguars, will be featured on the ThunderVision video boards, with Tebow being recognized as the Legend of the Game.

Why Tebow's return is trending now

Tebow's return to the stadium, where he threw his last overtime touchdown in 2012, comes amid the Broncos' opening season and sparks strong interest among fans who remember his clutch plays.

Tebow's history with the Broncos

Tebow was selected in the first round of the 2010 draft and began the 2011 season with an overtime victory against the Steelers, in which he recorded two scores in the first half and, in the second half, threw an 80-yard touchdown to Demaryius Thomas to end the game. That play ranked 76th on the NFL's 100 Greatest Moments list.

Tebow's role as flag planter

In addition to planting the alumni flag, Tebow will be recognized on the video boards during a break in the game. The club also highlighted that he was an important figure for players like Pat Bryant, who grew up watching Tebow play and became a fan.

How current players view Tebow

Current quarterback Bo Nix commented that it will be "cool to see him back in his environment, in his spot" and that the relationship between them has grown over time. Nix also shared that he met Tebow at Auburn and that the two have had conversations and in-person meetings.

What comes after Sunday's opener

Following the flag planting and Tebow's recognition, the game against the Jaguars will proceed as the Denver team looks to maintain momentum in its opening season.
